title: AWS Secrets Manager
description: Keep connection strings and API keys safe in AWS Secrets Manager and use them from ASP.NET Core.
longDescription: Hardcoded secrets are a common security risk. This module shows how to move secrets into AWS Secrets Manager, fetch them in C#, use IAM roles to avoid credentials entirely, and integrate Secrets Manager with ASP.NET Core configuration.
whatYouLearn: Create and use AWS Secrets Manager secrets
Read secrets from C# using the AWS SDK
Use IAM roles instead of access keys
Compare Secrets Manager with Parameter Store
